author: Elijah Jero
name: NOAI
description: Analyzes Discord images with OpenAI CLIP to estimate whether they look AI-generated. Supports attachments, embeds, stickers, and replied-to messages. Text analysis is not implemented yet. Downloads the CLIP model on first use and uses extra pip packages (torch, transformers, pillow).
install_msg: NOAI loaded. This cog has heavy memory/CPU use: it installs torch, transformers, and pillow, and downloads openai/clip-vit-base-patch32 on first analysis. Enable it with `[p]noai enableimages true`, then `[p]noai analyze` with an image.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores per-guild enable flags and an image-score threshold. Images are processed locally with CLIP; they are not uploaded to a third-party API.
